literal: All resources and having, in times of need that helps, excellent defenders that which possesses, is a fortress.
translation: A true fortress is one that possesses all necessary resources and is manned by excellent defenders who will stand and help in times of need.
modern: எல்லாத் தேவையான பொருள்களையும் கொண்டு, ஆபத்து காலத்தில் உதவி செய்யக்கூடிய நல்ல வீரர்களைக் கொண்டிருப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential internal qualities of a strong fortress. It states that a fortress must not only be stocked with all necessary provisions and resources to withstand a long siege, but it must also be manned by capable, loyal, and brave defenders who will actively fight and help during a crisis. The word 'ஆள்' here refers to the soldiers or defenders, and 'நல்' emphasizes their skill and loyalty. Without both material resources and dependable defenders, a physical structure cannot function as a true fortress.
